intro: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts is a task undertaken on behalf of Kristy Grant, a traveler seeking the radiant coats of the Pesterhide hyenas in Thousand Needles. Lacking combat training herself, Kristy relies on capable adventurers to hunt the beasts and harvest their pelts. Her goal is to send these unique hides back across the sea to her sisters in Stormwind, where they can be fashioned into fine garments and goods.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Pesterhide hyenas of Thousand Needles have the most gorgeous coats. I haven't seen such a brilliant hue of fur like that in all of my travels!
I would like to send back some pelts to my sisters back in Stormwind, as I know they could make something incredible out of them.
I don't have any fighting experience, so I would be very grateful if you could gather some of the Pesterhide pelts in my stead.
